rows.answer: Under RBI rules, the total gold ornament weight a single borrower can pledge across all loans is capped at 1 kilogram. The aggregate weight of ornaments pledged for all loans to a borrower shall not exceed 1 kilogram for gold ornaments, and 10 kilograms for silver ornaments. This is an RBI requirement that applies to every bank, and the search results contain no Demo Bank rule on it.
rows.expected_answer: 1 kg gold ornaments (gold coins 50 g)
